items.title: J. Leo Rayhill interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 23, 2007

ctx.x: Okay. Did you own a car at the time?

No I did not. No. I never owned a car until later, much later, after I got out of school. But Hal Wagner, and Frank Fry, and my wonderful roommate, had a convertible and we were the toast of the campus for that I’ll tell you. How he ever sprung for it, but he was a great guy. He was a veteran. He’d come back. He’d served in the Battle of the Bulge and he had — both his legs had been severely damaged from the war, but he was a great guy and he was fun. He looked like Fred Astaire, and my fondest memory of him was…
How do you spell his last name?
